hypothesis: RUNTIME surface: `crystal-themes` numbered communities 0..n in Louvain order on every recompute, so a weekly recluster reshuffled theme ids — and with them theme URLs (`/knowledge/theme/<id>`, `ovp://theme-page/<id>`), theme_pages.json keys and the synthesis cluster keys `t{id:03}` — and re-paid a model call for every name. That made the scheduled weekly themes job unsafe to leave on (it had been off since 09-27 while 360+ new packs accumulated). v1 carries identity across runs: each new community inherits the id of the previous community it overlaps most (member Jaccard >= 0.3, greedy one-to-one, deterministic ties); unmatched communities get fresh ids from a persisted high-water mark (`next_id`) so a retired id is never reused; a community whose membership barely moved (Jaccard >= 0.6) keeps its previous name without a model call when that name came from the current labeling prompt. `--dry-run` prints kept / renamed / new / retired without writing. Predicted: weekly reruns keep existing theme ids for every continuing community and call the model only for new or substantially changed communities.

predicted_delta.operational_reliability: theme ids stable across reruns for continuing communities; retired ids never reassigned
predicted_delta.cost_efficiency: model calls per weekly run drop from one per community to one per new/changed community

guardrails.first_run_unchanged: no previous themes.json → ids 0..n in clustering order exactly as before
guardrails.corrupt_previous_file: an unreadable previous themes.json carries nothing (fresh ids) and never fails the run
guardrails.legacy_files: files without `next_id` / `label_prompt` load (serde default); the high-water mark falls back to past-the-max surviving id
guardrails.projection_only: themes.json stays a rebuildable projection; nothing is written to the ledger

eval_plan.replay_set: ovp-cli tests: carry_ids (inherit by overlap, split keeps the larger share, fresh ids past retired ones, high-water mark honored), reused_name (only current prompt + stable membership), change_lines, and an end-to-end rerun where a new pack joins an existing community (ids unchanged; --dry-run writes nothing)

rollback: Revert crystal_themes.rs to number communities 0..n; delete themes.json to rebuild. Ignored fields (`next_id`, `label_prompt`) are harmless to older binaries.
